export.title: Your conversations
export.intro: Download the signed evidence record of any of your conversations. It verifies offline against the published keys.
export.loadFailed: Your conversations could not be loaded.
export.downloadLabel: Download evidence of the conversation started {date}
export.downloadFailed: The evidence could not be downloaded. Try again.
export.carveOut: Receipts and transaction references are kept for 7 years under the financial record-keeping obligation, even after you erase your data. They hold the on-chain addresses and amounts of approved transactions, which are public on the ledger.
export.eraseGuest: Sign in to erase your data. Guest conversations are removed automatically after 30 days.
export.eraseText: Message text, tool results and unsigned transaction data of all your conversations are removed now. This cannot be undone.
export.eraseKept: Kept: evidence hashes, signed receipts and transaction IDs, so an exported bundle still verifies.
export.actionInFlight: Finish or cancel the action first, then erase your data.
export.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again to erase your data.
export.eraseFailed: Your data could not be erased. Try again.
export.erased: Your data was erased. A new conversation has started.
